I start work at 8am and cannot wait in a telephone queue at that time, never mind find a private space to speak when they call back. Actually though, my review is because my mum was sent for a scan urgently as ?cancer, the doctor called on Friday and asked her to call her back asap, she couldn’t get through for half an hour and eventually was so worried she drove to the practice- to be told, yes the doctor knows and will call back.
